description: This file defines the class `Smarty_Internal_Method_CompileAllTemplates`, which provides methods for compiling all templates or configuration files in Smarty. It contains methods that manage iteration over template directories, compile templates, handle errors, and manage compilation settings.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_CompileAllTemplates
classes.description: Class providing methods to compile all Smarty templates and configuration files.

methods.name: compileAllTemplates
methods.description: Public method to compile all template files, with options for extension, forced recompilation, and error handling.

methods.description: Protected method that performs the actual compilation of all templates or config files within given directories, handling file iteration and error management.
